description: This PHP class implements a renderer for a Table of Contents within a markdown content processing system, integrating with the CommonMark library and a custom configuration to generate the final HTML output.

classes.name: TableOfContentsRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for generating the HTML representation of a table of contents for markdown content using the CommonMark library and custom configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with configuration settings and prepares a list block renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the TableOfContents node into HTML, embedding it within a theme partial using the configured template engine.
